title: Tanvi Sharma Beats Unnati Hooda, Reaches Syed Modi Final

title: BWF's Thomas and Uber Cup Overhaul Divides Badminton Community

title: Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand Advance to Syed Modi Quarterfinals

title: BAI Announces Election Date for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: This announcement sets the stage for the future leadership of Indian badminton, impacting player development and national policies.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced that its forthcoming elections will be held on December 26, 2026, in Guwahati, determining the new office bearers.

title: Mini National Badminton Championships Venue Shifted to Raipur
